scope: Operator-observed UI workflows in the managed Chrome preview, plus explicitly identified actual downloads. This record is not HTTPS/offline/update, public deployment, full cross-browser, or native print/PDF acceptance.

workflows.name: Restored prior result on rc.3 load
workflows.observed: The rc.2 continuous snapshot opened as Showing saved result, Latest 17.5 ms, with explicit non-resumable completed-window text.

workflows.name: Continuous run and pause
workflows.observed: Started a new digital source/inverter/indicator session. Running at 100 us; paused at 4.9 ms with 21 retained points and a retained-state explanation.

workflows.name: Initial input and acknowledged live drive remain distinct
workflows.observed: While paused at 4.9 ms, setting DV1 LOW left Initial HIGH visible and changed Live drive to LOW, applied at 4.9 ms. Indicators remained HIGH/LOW until Step.

workflows.name: Step computes the source response
workflows.observed: One step completed at 5 ms with 22 retained points. IND1 became LOW and IND2 HIGH.

workflows.name: Historical display and return to latest
workflows.observed: Cursor A at 3.918582375478927 ms showed the earlier HIGH/LOW lamps while the live drive stayed LOW. Return displays to the latest retained time restored LOW/HIGH at 5 ms without changing the paused simulated time or 22-point count.

workflows.name: Resume and stop
workflows.observed: Resume returned to Running at 5.4 ms. Stop kept the result at 10.1 ms, marked Showing saved result and Recorded drive LOW applied at 4.9 ms, and explained that a new session is required.

workflows.name: Bounded result and edited circuit
workflows.observed: A bounded 2 ms run showed Results ready. Editing the source to LOW marked the older result as another revision and rendered both current indicators NO RESULT.

workflows.name: Completed Step state refresh
workflows.beforeFix: The initial build left Advancing one step visible after a completed paused step until another view render. This was a presentation lifecycle defect, not a numerical failure.
workflows.fix: The app now refreshes state after the owned Step promise settles and ignores late completion from a replaced session.
workflows.observed: After reload into the final build, Pause at 1.1 ms followed by Step at 1.2 ms immediately returned to Paused with Circuit state is retained and an enabled Step button.
workflows.regressions: Two application regressions reproduce the pre-fix presentation and late old-session error cases and pass after the fix.

workflows.name: Final bounded source/indicator example
workflows.observed: Revision 4, Initial HIGH, completed 2 ms result: IND1 HIGH/red and IND2 LOW/dark; no simulation running.

workflows.name: Actual project download and normal UI import
workflows.observed: Downloaded the real backup, reopened that same file through Open project and the file chooser, and confirmed Replace working project. The state strip then said Showing saved result / Recorded evidence; run the experiment to compute a fresh result. Latest 2 ms and HIGH/LOW indicators were retained.
workflows.historyCaution: The backup includes three previously imported runs and four newly observed runs. Project snapshot appVersion is not an execution-build identifier; the initial reused project still carried rc.2 metadata.

workflows.name: Actual result CSV download
workflows.observed: Five columns and two data rows at 0 and 0.002 s; both source columns are 1 and both inverter columns are 0.

workflows.name: Actual installation JSON download
workflows.observed: The final downloaded JSON was recovered and parsed. An earlier attempt returned a path whose bytes were unavailable; the final retry succeeded.

workflows.name: SVG download delivery
workflows.observed: Export schematic SVG displayed Schematic SVG downloaded, but the documented download event timed out after 15 seconds. No actual SVG file was recovered; file delivery is not claimed.

workflows.name: HTML report preview and delivery
workflows.observed: The printable report iframe rendered the circuit title, evidence, assumptions, interpretation, provenance, diagnostics and exact simulation input sections. The visible HTML download link timed out using both the normal download event and documented link download API. Actual report file delivery is not claimed.
